name: Anthony Knutson
research_summary: Knutson's listed work develops computer simulation tools for hypersonic flows, including flow solvers and mesh refinement. His publications also examine interactions among gas flow, materials, and structures, and the balance between accuracy and computational cost in trajectory simulations.
